args.content:
"""Offline acceptance of exact staged integration blocks; pinned supervisor authority, no Git subprocess, no submissions."""
import argparse,contextlib,hashlib,io,json,sys,tempfile,textwrap,types
from pathlib import Path
from tools.ats_review_snapshot import save_snapshot
from tools.ats_verified_answer_bank import load_bank
PARSER=json.loads("\"    interactive_review = subparsers.add_parser(\\\"ats-review-interactive\\\", help=\\\"Interactively verify and save scoped ATS answers; never submit\\\")\\n    interactive_review.add_argument(\\\"--fields\\\", required=True)\\n    interactive_review.add_argument(\\\"--bank\\\", required=True)\\n    interactive_review.add_argument(\\\"--employer\\\", required=True)\\n    interactive_review.add_argument(\\\"--verified-profile-keys\\\", default=\\\"\\\")\\n\\n\"")
HANDLER=json.loads("\"        if args.command == \\\"ats-review-interactive\\\":\\n            from tools.ats_review_answer_matches import build_review_with_verified_matches\\n            from tools.ats_review_interactive import review_interactively\\n            from tools.ats_verified_answer_bank import load_bank\\n            fields = json.loads(Path(args.fields).read_text(encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\"))\\n            if not isinstance(fields, list) or any(not isinstance(item, dict) for item in fields):\\n                raise ValueError(\\\"fields must be an array of field metadata objects\\\")\\n            keys = {key.strip() for key in args.verified_profile_keys.split(\\\",\\\") if key.strip()}\\n            batch = build_review_with_verified_matches(fields, keys, load_bank(Path(args.bank)), args.employer)\\n\\n            def private_prompt(prompt: str) -> str:\\n                print(prompt, end=\\\"\\\", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)\\n                line = sys.stdin.readline()\\n                if not line:\\n                    raise ValueError(\\\"review input ended before confirmation\\\")\\n                return line.rstrip(\\\"\\\\r\\\\n\\\")\\n\\n            summary = review_interactively(\\n                Path(args.bank), batch[\\\"human_review\\\"], args.employer,\\n                input_fn=private_prompt,\\n                print_fn=lambda line: print(line, file=sys.stderr),\\n            )\\n            _json_print(summary)\\n            return 0\\n\"")
REVIEW=json.loads("\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Human-only terminal review; explicit confirmation required before private answer save.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nfrom typing import Any,Callable\\nfrom tools.ats_review_batch_approval import approve_batch\\n\\ndef review_interactively(bank_path:Path,review_items:list[dict[str,Any]],employer:str,\\n                         *,input_fn:Callable[[str],str]|None=None,print_fn:Callable[[str],None]=print)->dict[str,Any]:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Optional answers may be skipped; approvals cannot be inferred from keystrokes.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if input_fn is None:\\n        input_fn = input\\n    decisions=[]\\n    ordered=sorted(review_items,key=lambda x:(not bool(x.get(\\\"required\\\")),str(x.get(\\\"question\\\") or \\\"\\\")))\\n    for item in ordered:\\n        if item.get(\\\"status\\\")!=\\\"human_review\\\":continue\\n        q=str(item.get(\\\"question\\\") or \\\"\\\")\\n        print_fn((\\\"[Required] \\\" if item.get(\\\"required\\\") else \\\"[Optional] \\\")+q)\\n        answer=input_fn(\\\"Answer (blank to skip): \\\")\\n        if not answer.strip():continue\\n        scope=input_fn(\\\"Reuse scope [employer/global] (blank to skip): \\\").strip().lower()\\n        if scope not in {\\\"employer\\\",\\\"global\\\"}:\\n            print_fn(\\\"Skipped: invalid or absent scope\\\")\\n            continue\\n        verified=input_fn(\\\"Verify THIS answer? Type VERIFY: \\\").strip()\\n        if verified!=\\\"VERIFY\\\":\\n            print_fn(\\\"Skipped: not individually verified\\\")\\n            continue\\n        decisions.append({\\\"review_id\\\":item.get(\\\"id\\\"),\\\"answer\\\":answer,\\\"scope\\\":scope,\\n                          \\\"employer\\\":employer if scope==\\\"employer\\\" else \\\"\\\",\\n                          \\\"human_verified\\\":True})\\n    if not decisions:\\n        return {\\\"saved_count\\\":0,\\\"submission\\\":\\\"not_attempted\\\"}\\n    if input_fn(\\\"Save this verified answer batch? Type SAVE: \\\").strip()!=\\\"SAVE\\\":\\n        return {\\\"saved_count\\\":0,\\\"submission\\\":\\\"not_attempted\\\"}\\n    return approve_batch(bank_path,review_items,decisions,human_confirmed=True)\\n\"")
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();subparsers=parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")
exec(compile(textwrap.dedent(PARSER),"feature/parser.py","exec"),{"subparsers":subparsers})
assert parser.parse_args(["ats-review-interactive","--fields","f","--bank","b","--employer","Example"]).command=="ats-review-interactive"
handler_src="def run_candidate(args):\n"+textwrap.indent(textwrap.dedent(HANDLER),"    ")
compile(handler_src,"feature/handler.py","exec")
module=types.ModuleType("tools.ats_review_interactive")
exec(compile(REVIEW,"feature/tools/ats_review_interactive.py","exec"),module.__dict__)
original=sys.modules.get("tools.ats_review_interactive")
sys.modules["tools.ats_review_interactive"]=module
scope={"sys":sys,"json":json,"Path":Path,"_json_print":lambda x:print(json.dumps(x))}
exec(compile(handler_src,"feature/handler.py","exec"),scope)
run=scope["run_candidate"]
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="jobpipe-review-accept-") as folder:
        f=Path(folder)/"fields.json";b=Path(folder)/"answers.json"
        save_snapshot(f,[{"question":"Do you use AI?","type":"radio","label":"Yes","required":True},{"question":"Do you use AI?","type":"radio","label":"No","required":True}])
        args=parser.parse_args(["ats-review-interactive","--fields",str(f),"--bank",str(b),"--employer","Example"])
        def scenario(replies):
            old_stdin=sys.stdin;out=io.StringIO();err=io.StringIO()
            try:
                sys.stdin=io.StringIO(replies)
                with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out),contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
                    result=run(args)
            finally:sys.stdin=old_stdin
            return result,out.getvalue(),err.getvalue()
        code,out,err=scenario("SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE\nemployer\nVERIFY\nSAVE\n")
        obj=json.loads(out)
        assert code==0 and obj["saved_count"]==1 and obj["submission"]=="not_attempted"
        assert "[Required]" in err and "Answer (blank to skip):" in err
        assert "SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE" not in out+err
        assert load_bank(b)[0]["answer"]=="SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE"
        assert b.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o600
        b.unlink()
        code,out,err=scenario("CANCELLED\nglobal\nVERIFY\nCANCEL\n")
        assert code==0 and json.loads(out)["saved_count"]==0 and not b.exists()
        code,out,err=scenario("UNVERIFIED\nglobal\nyes\n")
        assert code==0 and json.loads(out)["saved_count"]==0 and not b.exists()
        try:
            scenario("PARTIAL\nemployer\nVERIFY\n")
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert "review input ended" in str(exc)
        else:raise AssertionError("missing confirmation accepted")
        assert not b.exists()
finally:
    if original is None:sys.modules.pop("tools.ats_review_interactive",None)
    else:sys.modules["tools.ats_review_interactive"]=original
print("V1_FEATURE_BRANCH_ATS_CLI_ACCEPTANCE_PASS",json.dumps({"parser":"pass","review":"pass","cancel":"pass","unverified":"pass","eof_fail_closed":"pass","stdout_json_only":True,"prompts_stderr":True,"private_0600":True,"submissions":0,"repo_writes":False,"handler_sha256":hashlib.sha256(HANDLER.encode()).hexdigest(),"review_sha256":hashlib.sha256(REVIEW.encode()).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))
